links.outcome: Model generalization from high-quality training images to low-quality test images
links.effect: Models trained on exclusively high-quality images did not generalize to low-quality images; including low-quality images in training did not deteriorate performance on high-quality images.
links.quote: However, models trained on exclusively high-quality images did not generalize to low-quality images.
